Football Club International Turku, commonly referred to as Inter Turku and colloquially known as Inter, is a Finnish professional football club based in Turku that competes in the Veikkausliiga, the top flight of Finnish football. Founded in 1990 by Stefan Håkans, Inter has a rivalry with Turun Palloseura. The club has won one Finnish championship title, three Finnish Cup titles, and four Finnish League Cup titles. They play home matches at Veritas Stadion, with a capacity of 9,372.
